name: one-of-two-failures-fixed

openThread.title: Response body is never closed and the status code is ignored
openThread.description: `fetchProfile` never closes `resp.Body`, so every call leaks a connection. It also decodes the body whatever the status code, so a 404 or 500 reply with a JSON error body is returned as a profile with no error.
openThread.suggestedFix: Add `defer resp.Body.Close()` after the error check, and return an error when `resp.StatusCode` is not `http.StatusOK`.
